issues.title: Launcher crashing
issues.author: Billabong1985
issues.body: On 0.9.0, Steam deck, using the amd64 Appimage, trying to click on the settings or mods tabs causes the launcher to crash. The game itself seems to launch fine if I leave it on the first tab and just hit play

releases.name: v0.9.0
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The game

- **Gaspar's lava is back.** The lava sea was missing and only the sky showed under the level.
- **Loading a save from the pause menu no longer crashes the game.** The flight to the save's planet wrote over its own data (players saw it on Hoven). It now works as on the console.
- **Your language and sound settings are kept.** The game's language and its Sound page (playback mode, music and sound volume) come back at every start, and loading a save no longer replaces them with the…
